answer: Require each agent identity to lock a refundable bond that unlocks only after a long, auditable history, with weight tied to history, not account count. Every job emits a signed performance signal on latency, success, and disputes anyone can verify. The system turns those signals into a trust delta: good work raises weight slowly, one bad job cuts it sharply and can forfeit the bond, resetting the spiral of trust to zero. A sybil operator must fund a bond and build a clean history for every fake identity, so ten puppets cost ten bonds and ten waiting periods, while one honest agent pays once.
